stageName.text: On What Befell the Fair Dulcinea and Don Quixote

statNote.text: Enemy levels show the source's base values. The main body's Defense and skill levels account for Withered (−35). Adds show base Defense and skill levels; also check effects for individual buffs and Withered modifiers.

lead.text: Clear adds early to reduce the boss's Protection. Watch thorns that return Bleed to attackers and Unbreakable Coins that remain after Clash Wins; exploit the later Stagger for concentrated damage.

priorities.0.text: Do not rush damage on the main body. First defeat the 8 adds, including reinforcements, to reduce Protection.

priorities.1.text: Winning clashes does not prevent every hit. Check attacking Sinners' HP and Bleed Potency and Count every turn.

priorities.2.text: The enemy gains buffs at 66% and 33% HP. Use Stagger and strong skills to keep the latter half short.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Unable to damage the main body

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Protection gained each turn is the cause. Kill adds first to reduce it. Clear later reinforcements as well as the 3 visible enemies to trigger a special Stagger.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Unbreakable Coins still attack after you win. Attacking an enemy with Thorns also inflicts Bleed on the attacker. Reduce damage through clash wins while assigning attacks to Sinners with low Bleed Count.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Suddenly wiped out in the latter half

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Buffs at 66% and 33% HP strengthen Thorns and big attacks. Reduce Protection before damaging the main body too far, then use Stagger Thresholds to finish the latter half quickly.

units.0.stagger.text: 50% HP (1372) / Stagger from clearing all adds

units.0.notes.0.text: Withered lowers Offense and Defense Levels by 35. Base Defense Level is 87; it starts at 52. Aim for the recommended Lv.50 rather than matching the enemy's Lv.85.

units.0.notes.1.text: Gains further buffs at 66% HP or below (1812) and 33% or below (906). After the final big attack, each Physical resistance multiplier increases by 0.5, making her more vulnerable.

units.0.notes.2.text: Jia Xichun joins as an allied NPC. Check her random targets and clashes, and have Sinners intercept dangerous clashes.

units.1.notes.0.text: Defeat these to reduce the main body's Protection too. Prevent repeated Bleed and Rupture hits.

units.2.notes.0.text: Defeat these to reduce the main body's Protection too. Prevent repeated Bleed and Rupture hits.

units.3.notes.1.text: Defeating it reduces the main body's Protection, but Unstoppable Bliss may inflict Bleed Count on the attacker.

phases.0.title.text: Defeat adds before damaging the main body

phases.0.steps.0.text: Bring 6 deployed Sinners and 6 reserves, including Don Quixote. Xichun cannot be controlled, so check whether she is entering unfavorable clashes.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The main body gains 8 Protection each turn, reduced by 1 for each dead add. Prioritize adds rather than forcing clashes against the main body's Counter early on.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Clearing all 8 initial enemies, including reinforcements, triggers the main body's special Stagger. Check for remaining reinforcements, then focus strong attacks on the Staggered main body.

phases.0.steps.3.text: Defeated adds also grant E.G.O resources. Use these for healing or area attacks, while reducing the attack burden on Sinners whose Bleed Count has risen.

phases.1.title.text: Beat the Counter and turn add kills into a Stagger opening

phases.1.steps.0.text: The main body's Thorns strengthen, and the whole enemy team gains Fever and Thorns each turn. Longer fights become worse; clear adds to Stagger the main body.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Beating “And that's all it does...” removes 5 Thorns. At 5 Fever or more it also gains Clash Power, so assign a strong clasher.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Use the Stagger Threshold at 50% HP too. Avoid wasting it alongside the add-clear Stagger; watch remaining HP and attack order when focusing damage.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Check the attacker's Bleed Count before using area E.G.O. Hitting several enemies with Thorns can add Bleed Potency to the attacker from all of them.

phases.2.title.text: Win against the big attack, then finish the weakened main body

phases.2.steps.0.text: All 3 Coins of “The Finale” are Unbreakable. Attacks and Bleed remain after you win, but the enemy's clash loss halves damage and prevents this skill's damage from Staggering its targets.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Prioritize winning with a high-Power skill or E.G.O. This does not also prevent death from Bleed, so check the clasher's and other allies' HP.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Physical resistances weaken after the big attack. Avoid spreading too many attacks across adds; finish the main body with attackers who still have little Bleed.

skills.0.effects.0.text: Prioritizes non-Staggered allies on its own side. Against an ally, Clash Power +10 and damage is 0. Clash Power +1 per 3 Bleed on the target (max 3).

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed. If targeting its own ally, instead grant 3 Offense Level Up through next turn.

skills.0.response.text: You do not need to intercept every action that buffs an enemy ally. Prioritize adds early and handle attacks aimed at Sinners.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [On Use] Final Power +1 per 5 Fever on self or 6 Bleed on the target (max 4). If Bloodfeast is below 15, gain 15 Bleed, immediately activate it once, and reduce Count by 1. Below 10% HP, only the gain effect applies.

skills.2.effects.2.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up per 6 Bleed on the target (each max 3).

skills.2.effects.3.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit after Clash Win] Bleed Count +5. [On Hit] Gain 3 Blooming Thorn.

skills.2.response.text: Coin II is Unbreakable. Win to prevent the large Bleed Count increase, and assign a Sinner who can survive the remaining attack.

skills.3.effects.0.text: Indiscriminate. Main target prioritizes Sinners; additional targets prioritize its own allies. Against allies, Clash Power +10 and damage is 0.

skills.3.effects.1.text: [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 20 Bloodfeast consumed cumulatively (max 10). If Bloodfeast is below 25, gain 25 Bleed, immediately activate it once, and reduce Count by 1. Below 10% HP, only the gain effect applies.

skills.3.effects.2.text: [After Attack] Consume 25 Bloodfeast. [Turn End] Consume all Fever.

skills.3.effects.3.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Grant 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up through next turn per 3 Fever on the target (each max 3).

skills.3.effects.4.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Bleed Count +3. For its own allies, grant 5 Blooming Thorn instead.

skills.3.response.text: Do not predict it solely from the listed 4–12 range. Cumulative Bloodfeast and Thorn form strengthen it. It also grants Thorns to adds; check attackers' Bleed.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 20 Bloodfeast consumed cumulatively (max 10). If Bloodfeast is below 50, gain 25 Bleed and 2 Count, immediately activate it twice, and reduce Count by 2. Below 10% HP, only the gain effects apply. Then consume half the Bloodfeast.

skills.4.effects.1.text: [Turn End] Consume all Imperfect Parade and gain 10 Fever.

skills.4.effects.2.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Heal HP by 25% of the damage dealt.

skills.4.effects.3.text: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Heal HP by 50% of the damage dealt; inflict 5 Bleed and 5 Rupture. [After this Coin's attack] Gain 1 Thorn per 10 Bloodfeast consumed (max 10).

skills.4.response.text: An area attack after Imperfect Parade accumulates. Coin III remains, but breaking the first 2 Coins reduces healing and damage. In the final form, the healing effects become SP recovery.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [On Use] If at 5 Fever or more, Clash Power +3.

skills.5.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Gain 5 Blooming Thorn. [Clash Lose] Lose 5 Thorns.

skills.5.response.text: You can prioritize adds early. When attacking the main body later, win with a high-Power clasher to reduce Thorns before the remaining attacks.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [On Use] Consume half the Bloodfeast. Final-form Thorns grant Coin Power +2.

skills.6.effects.1.text: [Clash Win] Damage increases by the Bloodfeast consumed as a percentage (max 150%). [Clash Lose] Halve damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage.

skills.6.effects.2.text: [After Attack] Lose SP equal to Bloodfeast consumed.

skills.6.effects.3.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 6 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 6.

skills.6.effects.4.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 6 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 6.

skills.6.effects.5.text: Ⅲ：[After this Coin's attack] Gain 1 Thorn per 10 Bloodfeast consumed (max 10).

skills.6.response.text: Winning matters even when every Coin is Unbreakable. Gain the damage reduction and Stagger prevention, then focus attacks on the weakened main body. Watch for death from Bleed damage.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Maximum 10. On taking skill damage, inflict Bleed equal to half the value, rounded up, on the attacker, then decrease by 1. Does not expire at Turn End.

mechanics.0.response.text: Check attackers' Bleed Count as well as attack counts. Be careful when an area attack hits several enemies with Thorns.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Bleed returned to attackers equals the Thorn value. On Hit Bleed Potency and Count increase by 1 in the middle form and 2 in the final form. Bloodfeast-consuming skills also gain 1 Coin Power in the middle form and 2 in the final form. The final form also grants effects including +50% damage.

mechanics.1.response.text: Base Power tables alone cannot represent later strength. Recheck predictions after a phase change and attack during Stagger.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 10. Gain 1 Offense Level Up per 3 value (max 3). The main body uses its big attack at 10; adds at 8.

mechanics.2.response.text: Check the Counter's bonus at 5 Fever or more too.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Increases by 2 on a Bloodbag's death and 3 on a Bloodfiend's death. At Turn Start, gain 1 Fragile per 5 consumed cumulatively.

mechanics.3.response.text: Kill adds to trigger Stagger, then attack the main body with its Fragile.

mechanics.4.effect.text: On an add's death, gain 1 each of the 3 least abundant E.G.O resources. Inflict 3 Bleed Count on a Sinner, prioritizing the killer. Enemy Fever can also trigger buffs next turn.

mechanics.4.response.text: A kill does not guarantee safety. Recheck the clearing Sinner's Bleed Count every turn.

warnings.0.text: Unbreakable Coins remain after a clash win. Winning still matters: it breaks normal Coins and prevents On Hit effects that require the enemy to win the clash.

warnings.1.text: Xichun is an NPC: she does not receive effects targeting allied Sinners, and her skills do not generate E.G.O resources. Help her if she keeps losing strong clashes.

warnings.2.text: Damaging the main body into later phases before clearing the initial adds leaves Protection active and makes the fight harder.

warnings.3.text: “The Finale” after 33% HP leaves heavy Bleed. Stagger prevention is separate from death caused by Bleed.

preparation.0.text: Aim for the recommended Lv.50 on your main team, leveling as your resources allow. Don Quixote is mandatory.

preparation.1.text: Set 6 deployed Sinners and 6 reserves. Reserves receive starting SP modifiers, with the sign reversed for negative-Coin Identities. Plan their order and roles.

preparation.2.text: Prepare clashers, durable Sinners and healers to withstand Bleed, and damage for Stagger openings. Check resource generation for healing and area E.G.O.

preparation.3.text: Lust and Envy are effective against the main body; Lust works well against adds. Bleed and Rupture teams offer damage beyond attacking through Protection, but a dedicated keyword team is not required to win by clearing adds first.

roles.0.name.text: Clasher for the Counter and big attacks

roles.0.reason.text: Handle clashes with Fever and later buffs included. Do not spend every strong skill on regular attacks.

roles.1.reason.text: Reduce Protection while managing the clearing Sinner's accumulating Bleed Count and HP.

roles.2.reason.text: Save strong attacks for the Stagger at 50% HP and the weakness after “The Finale”.
